title: Rotterdam SO2 -> CF Industries 2d
hypothesis: R2 | [fertilizer-ag] Rotterdam CAMS SO2 20d z-score > 1 leads CF Industries returns by 2 days (+) as a cross-market check of the Yara result; trade long CF 2d [airquality.rotterdam.cams_so2 -> finance.CF.log_return]
message: Not supported: Rotterdam SO2 z>1 vs CF 2d r=-0.04 (n=389), best lag 6d r=-0.09; long CF rule excess return -0.28%, OOS hit 50%. Yara result does not cross to CF.

trade_idea.entry_rule: airquality.rotterdam.cams_so2 rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> long CF next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 6 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.
